note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.2 and current gr.go/gr_state.go (post-18b491ae23). Section 4.2 requires immediate removal of remaining stale routes for an address family upon receiving its End-of-RIB marker. onEORReceived validates the successor connection ID, checks wasStale (and clears llstExpiredDuringSync if present), removes fam from staleFamilies, stops any running LLST timer for fam, deletes peer state once both maps are empty, and returns (retainedSource, wasStale); handleEOREvent immediately dispatches source purge-stale scoped to that family. All 4 tagged units verified: TestGRStateManagerEORPurge purges IPv4 while keeping IPv6 active then completes on IPv6 EOR; TestRFC4724EndOfRIBRemovesThatFamilysStaleRoutes asserts the exact single source purge-stale command for IPv4; TestGRStateManagerEORForNonGRPeer returns false for non-GR peers; TestRFC4724EndOfRIBLeavesOtherFamiliesStale proves IPv6 is untouched, no whole-peer purge is sent, and an unretained family EOR dispatches nothing.
